FINITE STATE MACHINES / STATECHARTS TEST SUITE FOR U07_ALARMS

Statechart: Alarm System

States:
1. Idle
2. Medium Severity Alarm
3. High Severity Alarm
4. Apnea Alarm
5. Breath Rate Alarm
6. Pressure Low Alarm
7. Alarm Paused

Events:
- Alarm Triggered
- Alarm Paused
- Alarm Resumed
- Alarm Inhibited

Guards:
- Alarm Severity
- Alarm Type
- Alarm Paused

Lifecycle:
- Initialization
- Transition to Alarm
- Transition to Idle
- Transition to Alarm Paused
- Transition to Resumed

Mode-Switching Behaviour:
- From Idle to Alarm
- From Alarm to Idle
- From Alarm to Alarm Paused
- From Alarm Paused to Alarm
- From Alarm to Resumed


Test Cases:

TC-001: Medium Severity Alarm Indication
- Preconditions: None
- Inputs: Alarm Severity = Medium
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Alarm Indicated with Yellow Color, Flashing Frequency = 0.5Hz

TC-002: High Severity Alarm Indication (1)
- Preconditions: None
- Inputs: Alarm Severity = High, Pulse Count = 10
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Auditory Signal = 10 Pulses, Pulse Duration = 200ms, Pulse Frequency = 500Hz

TC-003: High Severity Alarm Indication (2)
- Preconditions: None
- Inputs: Alarm Severity = High, Pulse Count = 4
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Auditory Signal = 4 Pulses, Pulse Duration = 200ms, Pulse Frequency = 500Hz

TC-004: Alarm Pause
- Preconditions: All Alarms Active
- Inputs: AUDIO PAUSE / ALARM PAUSE Key Pressed
- Steps: Pause Alarms
- Expected: Alarm Pause for 60 Seconds, Display Symbol IEC 60417-5576

TC-005: Apnea Alarm Indication
- Preconditions: No Breath Triggered within Apnea Time Interval
- Inputs: Alarm Type = Apnea
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Medium Priority Alarm, Display Text = "APNEA ALARM"

TC-006: Breath Rate Alarm Indication
- Preconditions: Breath Rate Exceeded Setting
- Inputs: Alarm Type = Breath Rate
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Medium Level Alarm, Display Text = "HIGH BREATH RATE"

TC-007: Pressure Low Alarm Indication
- Preconditions: Low Pressure Detected
- Inputs: Alarm Type = Pressure Low
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: High Severity Alarm, Display Text = "LOW INSP P"

TC-008: Maximum Breath Rate Setting
- Preconditions: None
- Inputs: Breath Rate Setting = Maximum
- Steps: Trigger Alarm
- Expected: Alarm Threshold Acts as Maximum Breath Rate Setting
